summary: Comprehensive backend API testing for unitxt iteration 3 - credits-based wallet system. All 41 tests passed. Verified: login for 3 users, credits-based wallet, credit packs (4 seeded), credits rates, messaging with credit deduction, mobile prefixes (14 TZ prefixes), prefix lookup (Tigo/Vodacom), admin credit packs CRUD, margin reports, sender ID approval/renewal with credit charges, DLR webhook, account recovery, settings hub, RBAC, and no _id leaks.
critical_code_review_comments: All new endpoints properly implement RBAC (admin-only for prefixes CRUD, credit packs CRUD, margin reports)
clean(_id) properly applied to all responses - no MongoDB _id leaks
Credits system working correctly: TZ=1 credit, KE=2 credits, US=5 credits, WhatsApp=3 credits
Sender ID approval charges 500 credits and sets expires_at ~365 days
Sender ID renewal charges 500 credits and extends expires_at
DLR webhook updates message status correctly
Margin report aggregates revenue_usd, cost_usd, margin_usd, margin_pct with by_country, by_reseller, by_provider, daily breakdowns
TigoTZAdapter selected for providers with 'tigo' in name (verified: 'Tigo Tanzania (Direct)' provider exists)
seed_data_creation: Seeded automatically: 4 credit packs (Starter/Growth/Scale/Enterprise), 14 TZ mobile prefixes (Vodacom/Tigo/Airtel/Halotel/TTCL/Zantel), credits settings (country_rate, whatsapp_rate, sender_id_cost, etc.), Tigo Tanzania provider
